title: No test ever opens Change start date on screen
what: The only test of moving a plan's start checks the stored dates and one source line. No browser test opens the sheet, so its hint, the greyed button, the overlap and 31-day words, the success message and the history line on the member page are never seen. A broken sheet would pass every test.
expected: A phone test opens Change start date on a future plan, checks the hint and greyed button, picks a new day, saves, and sees the message and the history line; one overlap and one too-early day show their words.
fix_line: Add one phone test that drives the Change start date sheet

title: Offline renewals, offline Dues-list payments and a device not ready for offline are never tested
what: The offline tests take one payment from the member page and one payment with no answer, both as the owner. No test renews a membership offline, collects from the Dues list offline, or opens a money sheet offline on a device that never got its own receipt series, so the words that stop a clashing receipt number are never seen. The out-of-space words are never tested either.
expected: Phone tests renew offline and see the device's own receipt number, collect from Dues offline, and try a payment offline on a device with no receipt series and see the connect-once words with nothing saved.
fix_line: Add three offline phone tests: renew, Dues list, and a device with no receipt series

title: Pay online is tested only on Collect payment as the owner; Send to their app and the Sell sheet QR never
what: The one online-payment phone test shows the UPI QR and a payment link on Collect payment, signed in as the owner. No test presses Send to their app, shows the UPI QR on Sell membership (where the money box should fill with the total), presses Copy link or Send on WhatsApp, or opens any of it as the front desk.
expected: Phone tests cover Send to their app, the Sell membership QR, Copy link, and the desk's view of Pay online.
fix_line: Extend the online payment phone test to Sell membership, Send to their app and a desk login

title: No screen test shows the desk being stopped from taking cash for a link the member just paid
what: Closing open links before cash, and refusing the cash when the link was paid a moment ago, are tested only on the server and as words in a unit test. No phone test opens Collect payment with an open link, so nobody sees that the sheet stays open with the just-paid words, or that the cash is saved once the link is closed. The offline case, where the check is skipped, is not tested at all.
expected: A phone test makes a link, has the pretend company mark it paid, taps Save payment for cash, and sees the just-paid words with the sheet still open and no cash receipt; a second run with the link unpaid saves the cash and the link is closed.
fix_line: Add a phone test of cash on a due with an open payment link

title: Freeze / extra days is tested on screen only once, for 7 days on a renewal
what: One phone test adds 7 days. No test opens the sheet on an ended plan (the still-ended warning), on a PT pack (sessions left), with 0, 366 or 3.5 days (the 1 to 365 words and greyed button), or checks that the desk has no button. The refusals are tested only in the stored data.
expected: Phone tests open the sheet on an ended plan and a PT pack, type bad day counts, and sign in as the desk to see no button.
fix_line: Add phone checks for ended plans, PT packs, bad day counts and the desk view

title: The mobile number boxes on sign-in, Enquiries, Forgot PIN and Staff are never filled on screen, and the wrong-number words never checked
what: The phone test fills only the new-gym box and the Add member box. The sign-in, Enquiries, Forgot PIN and Staff and sign-in boxes are covered only by the shared rule tables, which cannot catch a box that forgets to use the rule. The member form's "This mobile number looks wrong" words are never checked anywhere.
expected: The phone test also fills the sign-in, Enquiries, Forgot PIN and Staff boxes, and a foreign or short number on Add member shows the wrong-number words.
fix_line: Run the same paste-and-type checks on the four other boxes

title: A test locks in that extra digits in front of a number are dropped without a word
what: The shared number table expects "1234 98765 43210" to become 9876543210. So when two numbers or a stray code are pasted, the box keeps the last 10 digits and drops the rest silently, and the test makes sure it stays that way.
expected: Extra leading digits that are not a country code are kept, so the box's check asks the person to fix the number.
fix_line: Decide the rule for extra leading digits and change that table line to match

title: Several Collect payment messages are never checked
what: No test types a bad amount ("That amount looks wrong"), clears the date ("Pick the date you got this money"), types a far-off year ("Check the year"), opens the sheet for a member with no dues, or sees "Still due after this" for a part payment on Collect payment. Zero is refused only in the stored data, with different words than the screen.
expected: A phone test types each bad value on Collect payment and sees its words, and one part payment shows the still-due line.
fix_line: Add the missing bad-value checks to the Collect payment phone test

title: Who-took-the-money is never tested after a rename, on a shared phone, or for a link paid while the sheet is open
what: The taker tests cover the owner, one desk person and a browser-only gym. No test renames or removes the desk person and rechecks old receipts and Collections, and no test checks the taker on a receipt that saves itself from a payment link.
expected: Tests rename a desk person and see old receipts keep the old name, and a link paid while the desk's sheet is open names that desk person.
fix_line: Add rename and payment-link cases to the receipt taker tests

title: The workout code check is never tested after a reward, on Cancel, or for a member with no plan
what: The one phone test checks a code and gives 3 days once. No test checks the same code again after the reward, cancels the Freeze sheet, reopens Freeze to see the reward setting cleared, or uses a member with no gym plan.
expected: Phone tests recheck a rewarded code, cancel, reopen Freeze on its normal start, and check a member with only a PT pack.
fix_line: Add repeat, cancel and no-plan cases to the workout code phone test
